prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic vertical kitchen mirror selfie of an approved adult, preserving the flour-smudged face, black T-shirt, pajama shorts, messy counter, and laughing energy.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with slightly messy short-to-medium hair, bright green eyes, sun-kissed skin with natural texture, laughing with an open smile and white flour on her nose and cheek. Wear a plain black T-shirt and comfortable printed pajama shorts; hands lightly dusted with flour.
prompt.composition_elements: Leaning over a kitchen island with elbows resting on the counter, one hand holding the phone and the other near the face. Capture through a reflective kitchen cabinet or window at eye level, with bowl of dough, scattered flour, and cracked eggshells. Vertical 4:5.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright overhead kitchen lighting, natural skin and flour detail, playful domestic mess, candid joyful atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, vertical 4:5, sharp face and flour texture, natural proportions, no filters or beautification.
